uncertain.note: The mark after marker {c} is a small round dot on the baseline with no descender, so read as a period; commas elsewhere on this page (e.g. 'du cœur,') clearly descend. A comma would fit the sense better, so this could be a comma whose tail failed to print. escalate.

uncertain.note: Marker {c} has no corresponding margin note: the margin is blank beside and below note 'b', there is no foot block, and nothing is printed lower on the page. The note for key 'c' is missing from this page (presumably it runs on to the next page).

uncertain.note: Last word of the page: the final letter is an over-inked blob; read as 'n' ('en'), but 'ea'/'ez' cannot be fully excluded. No hyphen is printed, so the word may or may not continue on the next page.

Heavily over-inked line in small italic: read 'tans' (giving 'Corin/tans' for Corinthiens), but the blotted middle could be 'tiens' or 'thiens'. Spacing before the first period is tighter than in note 'a' ('Pierre .c.v.'). escalate.
